<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Missing audit log export for compliance",
 "problem_statement": "Admins cannot export full audit logs, preventing compliance teams from meeting internal review deadlines. This delays audits and increases risk of non-compliance."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-10-01",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 1,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "account_management": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 150000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Brantwick Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 150000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-05-11",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "948c66e71bd187ff",
  "quote": "we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team... we really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines",
  "account": "Brantwick Commercial",
  "route": "account_management",
  "date": "2026-09-01T12:50:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

<previous_draft>
## Problem
Admins cannot export full audit logs from the Keelwater platform. This prevents compliance teams from conducting required reviews, leading to missed internal deadlines, delayed audits, and an increased risk of non-compliance.

## Who is affected
- **Account administrators** who are responsible for generating compliance reports and cannot export the necessary audit data [i:948c66e71bd187ff].
- **Internal compliance teams** at customer organizations who rely on exported logs to meet their review deadlines [i:948c66e71bd187ff].

## Evidence
The problem is reported by 1 account [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. It has been mentioned 1 time, specifically through the account management route [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. The affected account, Brantwick Commercial, has stated that they can pull full audit logs for admin review but that it is becoming urgent for their compliance team, and they really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. This account has an ARR of £150,000.0 [i:948c66e71bd187ff].

## Why now
The customer, Brantwick Commercial, indicated the need is becoming urgent as of 2026-09-01 [i:948c66e71bd187ff]. With 0 renewals in the last 90 days, retaining this high-value account may depend on addressing this compliance-critical feature gap before their renewal date on 2027-05-11 [i:948c66e71bd187ff].
</previous_draft>
